messages:
Maya (partnerships): quick sync — after yesterday's noisy Sev1 with the CloudAxis marketplace listing, we need a tight playbook for partner SEVs that covers: shared channels, bot triage, who owns the war room, and postmortem handoff. thoughts? :eyes:
Ethan (support): +1. the gap yesterday was: partner team posted in their channel, we didn't get auto-invite to a shared war room, and support ended up creating a dup channel. wasted ~20min.
Lina (eng-sre): can we standardize creation + auto-join for specific partner tags? e.g. if partner tag = cloudaxis and sevelvl >=1 auto-create #partner-sev-cloudaxis-s1 and invite lists.
Ravi (customer-success): partner contacts also need to be explicitly invited (not just proxied). CS should be on the invite list for marketplace partners. Claire can we add a required checklist for partner invites?
Claire (ops): yes, we can. propose: 1) channel naming conv 2) oncall list + partner reps 3) bot triage flow 4) war room roles doc. I'll sketch a template. :white_check_mark:
Maya (partnerships): draft naming conv: ```#partner-sev-{partner}-{sev}{-region?}``` examples: ```#partner-sev-cloudaxis-s1-us``` and ```#partner-sev-nimbleedge-s2-eu```. keep short and machine-parsable.
Ethan (support): love machine-parsable. also need a TTL tag for the channel, e.g. pinned message: "expected-close: <iso>" so bots can auto-arch.
Lina (eng-sre): ok, automation bits: partner-bot will listen for the webhook from partner portal or support create form. sample flow: ```on webhook -> create channel -> invite @support-oncall,@eng-sre-oncall, partner-reps -> post triage template -> pin runbook link```
partner-bot: [automated] Received new partner SEV webhook (source=cloudaxis, severity=1, region=us). Creating channel #partner-sev-cloudaxis-s1-us and inviting: Maya (partnerships), Ethan (support), Lina (eng-sre).
Ravi (customer-success): for marketplace listings, CS must be tagged as "primary contact" in the portal. If missing partner-bot should DM Maya to confirm.
Maya (partnerships): roles we used yesterday that worked: triage lead (Support), infra lead (Eng-SRE), partner liaison (Partnerships/CS), ops lead (Ops). propose adding a "comms" role responsible for external partner updates every 30m.
Claire (ops): add the comms cadence into the pinned triage template. Template snippet: ```- Incident summary (1 line) - Affected customers/partners - Preliminary mitigation - Next update ETA (hh:mm UTC) - Actions owners (triage, infra, partner-liaison, comms)```
Ethan (support): escalation matrix idea: S1 -> immediate war room w/in 5m, page paged teams + partner-liaison; S2 -> war room optional, notify leads; S3 -> async channel. can we enforce via bot?
Lina (eng-sre): yes, enforce. bot rule examples: ```if severity==1: page @eng-sre-oncall + @support-oncall; create channel; escalate to execs if not acknowledged in 10m```
Maya (partnerships): ownership question: who owns postmortem write-up for partner SEVs? recommend joint: Support writes ops timeline, Partnerships writes partner communications timeline, Eng-SRE writes root-cause. then single consolidated doc. :handshake:
Ravi (customer-success): agree. also include a short Q/A doc to share with partner explaining expected response times, escalation contacts, and who to reach for SLA exceptions.
Claire (ops): I'll add automation to create a postmortem checklist item in our tracker when partner-bot closes a channel. includes links: runbook, transcript, artifacts.
partner-bot: [automated] Channel #partner-sev-cloudaxis-s1-us created at 1719802469. Triage template posted.
Ethan (support): small nit — naming_convention should include internal short code for partner (avoid spaces/long names). Partnerships pls maintain partner-code registry.
Maya (partnerships): agreed. I'll add partner-codes to the partner registry spreadsheet and add a read-only copy to the ops runbook.
Lina (eng-sre): final ask: we need an oncall-lane mapping doc so partner-bot can resolve who to page for each partner and region. example mapping: ```cloudaxis: us->eng-sre-us-lane, eu->eng-sre-eu-lane```
Ravi (customer-success): once we have that mapping, CS can pre-fill partner contacts. Also want a Slack workflow to add partner rep to the channel via /invite-partner <partner-code>.
Claire (ops): will prototype the workflow and bot changes this week. ETA: PR by Thu.
Maya (partnerships): next steps: Claire to PR bot automation, Lina to publish oncall mapping, Ethan to update support runbook, Ravi to update partner contact registry. we'll reconvene Fri 10am PT. sound good? :thumbsup:
Ethan (support): +1
Lina (eng-sre): +1
Ravi (customer-success): +1
partner-bot: [automated reminder] Meeting scheduled: Fri 10:00 PT for partner SEV playbook review.
Maya (partnerships): thanks team — goal: one-minute to join correct war room and clear ownership within 10m consistently. I'll post the consolidated playbook after Fri.
